AHSC-35-ui.detail: RelayContract.ts:4 RelayEventName and :75-78 relayEventType expose the contract events, including agent_history_config_changed -> 'agent_history.config.changed' (present in config/pycore_relay_contract.json). The page's inline prompt.new bridge was extracted into one shared helper, bridgeRelayDeviceEvent (PycoreLaravelRelayTransport.ts:222-235, exported at core/integrations/pycore/index.ts:86), which re-dispatches the hub frame's metadata on the local topic, as the old code did. PcAgentHistoryPage.tsx:374-377 now uses it for prompt.new and no longer imports RELAY_CONTRACT or laravelRelayOperationEvents directly. AgentHistoryRuntimeStore.ts:340 bridges agent_history_config_changed onto PYCORE_EVENT_TOPICS.agentHistoryConfigChanged inside runtimeUnsubscribers, so it is torn down with the store (:357) and feeds the existing handler at :327-339 (payload.config applied without a refetch). laravelRelayOperationEvents.onEvent only registers a handler and opens no Mercure connection, so local mode is unaffected. Payload shape matches: pycore posts the bus payload (laravel_relay_agent_service.py:618-619) and Laravel wraps it as metadata (RelayDeviceService.php:104). Placement decision: the item asks for the subscription 'next to prompt.new'; it lives in the runtime store, which owns the config state and is also used by PcQueueCenterPage, PcAiProviderPromptsEditor and PcAgentHistoryConfigPanel, and PcAgentHistoryPage.tsx:374-376 points to it. Accepted as the better placement.
